notes: Canonical composition: SettingsPanel wraps SettingsLayout from @/_shared/ui; section nav is SectionNav inside the settings aside.
Member sees General only; administrator adds Model Provider, Knowledge Domains, Users.
Domain accordion rows are covered by domains-accordion — not duplicated here.
Synthetic labels only; no credentials, private IDs, runtime URLs, or server payloads.

geometry.density: h-8 section buttons; 2px leading active indicator

expectedTokenGeometry: Active section shows leading sky indicator and filled surface
Nav wraps to two columns on narrow, column on lg+

r10.keyboardTouch: section buttons are keyboard-focusable and activatable
r10.focus: active section button receives focus on Tab navigation
r10.screenReader: nav exposes Settings sections label; buttons carry section titles
r10.zoom: section labels remain present at component level
r10.darkLight: render under data-theme zai-dark and zai-light wrappers
r10.narrow: section nav flex-wrap below lg breakpoint
